import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Fill in the 'Select members to invite' textbox with 'Vinta'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite").fill("Vinta")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for autocomplete to appear

    await page.get_by_role("option", name="Vinta Chen @vinta").click()

    # Click the 'Add to project' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the action to complete
